title: Rewarding the Scientific Process: Process-Level Reward Modeling for Agentic Data Analysis
authors_zh: Zhisong Qiu、Shuofei Qiao、Kewei Xu、Yuqi Zhu、Lun Du、Ningyu Zhang、Huajun Chen
paper_type_zh: 数据分析智能体环境感知过程奖励模型论文
best_for_zh: 需要把可执行数据分析轨迹转成过程监督、搜索反馈或强化学习奖励的读者。
one_line: DataPRM probes execution states and assigns reflection-aware process rewards to train and guide data-analysis agents.
DataPRM 探测执行状态并赋予反思感知的过程奖励，用于训练和引导数据分析智能体。
why: It exposes a process-feedback object and its consumer in post-training.
inclusion_reason: The paper changes how process records, reward signals, or environment feedback are consumed by post-training optimization.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Data-analysis agents can execute code without raising an exception while still using a wrong table, an invalid interpretation, or an unsupported scientific claim. Outcome rewards therefore miss silent errors, while generic process judges can punish useful exploration merely because an intermediate attempt failed.

DataPRM asks how a process reward can distinguish grounded progress, correctable mistakes, and irrecoverable failures in an executable analysis environment. It treats interaction with the environment as part of judging a trajectory instead of reading an agent transcript in isolation.

数据分析智能体即使没有触发异常，也可能使用错误表格、作出无效解释或提出没有证据的科学主张。因此结果奖励会遗漏静默错误，而通用过程评判器可能仅因中间尝试失败就惩罚有用探索。

DataPRM 追问过程奖励如何在可执行分析环境中区分有依据的进展、可修正错误与不可挽回失败。它把与环境的交互视为轨迹判断的一部分，而不是孤立阅读智能体文本记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central record is a data-analysis trajectory with intermediate execution state, tool outputs, step-level annotation, and a process decision. The reward model can actively probe the environment, so a claimed result is checked against execution evidence rather than accepted only because its explanation is plausible.

Its reflection-aware reward separates errors that an agent can repair from failures that should terminate or strongly penalize a trajectory. This makes the feedback useful for both selecting candidate analyses and training a policy, but it also binds the record to the particular software environment and datasets used for evaluation.

核心记录是带有中间执行状态、工具输出、步骤级标注和过程决定的数据分析轨迹。奖励模型能够主动探测环境，因此一个声称的结果会依据执行证据被检查，而不会只因解释看似可信就被接受。

其反思感知奖励把智能体可修复的错误与应终止或强烈惩罚轨迹的失败分开。这使反馈既可用于选择候选分析，也可用于训练策略，但也让记录绑定于评测所用的具体软件环境和数据集。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors generate diverse trajectories, add knowledge-augmented step annotations, and construct more than 7,000 training instances. DataPRM then produces an environment-aware judgement and a ternary reward, using interaction to expose silent execution or grounding failures.

The official implementation is integrated in the DataMind repository, which documents the DataPRM component and reports KDD 2026 acceptance. The paper uses the resulting feedback for best-of-N selection and for reinforcement learning; no standalone official training-data release was confirmed, so the paper’s reported instances should not be treated as a downloadable dataset.

作者生成多样化轨迹，加入知识增强的步骤标注，并构造超过 7,000 条训练实例。DataPRM 随后生成环境感知判断和三元奖励，通过交互暴露静默执行或落地失败。

官方实现集成在 DataMind 仓库，其中记录了 DataPRM 组件并报告 KDD 2026 接收。论文将得到的反馈用于 Best-of-N 选择和强化学习；未确认独立官方训练数据发布，因此不能把论文所述实例当作可下载数据集。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports that DataPRM improves Best-of-N policy performance by 7.21% on ScienceAgentBench and 11.28% on DABStep, and that its RL setting reaches 78.73% on DABench and 64.84% on TableBench.

These results support the environment-aware feedback design in the reported data-analysis benchmarks. They do not establish that a reward model can safely generalize to a new notebook runtime, a different database, unavailable tools, or a scientific task whose ground truth cannot be probed through execution.

论文报告，DataPRM 在 Best-of-N 设置下使策略在 ScienceAgentBench 上提升 7.21%、在 DABStep 上提升 11.28%；其强化学习设置在 DABench 上达到 78.73%、在 TableBench 上达到 64.84%。

这些结果支持环境感知反馈设计在所报告数据分析基准中有效。它们并不证明奖励模型能安全泛化到新的笔记本运行时、不同数据库、不可用工具，或无法通过执行探测真值的科学任务。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Conventional process reward models judge a static text trace, and outcome-only agent training judges only whether an analysis eventually produces an accepted answer. Neither representation directly tests a seemingly valid intermediate state against the environment that produced it.

DataPRM changes the reward record by adding active state probing and a three-way distinction between progress, repairable failure, and irrecoverable failure. The novelty is an environment-coupled feedback contract for data-analysis trajectories, not simply another scalar scorer or an agent scaffold.

传统过程奖励模型判断静态文本轨迹，而只看结果的智能体训练只判断分析最终是否产生被接受的答案。这两种表示都不会直接用产生该状态的环境测试一个看似有效的中间状态。

DataPRM 通过加入主动状态探测，以及对进展、可修复失败和不可挽回失败的三分，改变奖励记录。新意在于面向数据分析轨迹的环境耦合反馈契约，而不只是另一个标量评分器或智能体框架。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Environment probing can be expensive, incomplete, or unsafe, and the model may still mistake a passing computation for a sound scientific inference. The code is public, but the paper does not provide a separately versioned training-data release; replication must reconstruct the environments, tools, seeds, and annotation procedure before claiming comparable process supervision.
环境探测可能昂贵、不完整或不安全，模型仍可能把通过的计算误认为可靠科学推断。代码虽已公开，但论文未提供单独版本化的训练数据发布；在声称可比较的过程监督前，复现必须重建环境、工具、随机种子和标注过程。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use DataPRM when an agent can replay analyses in a controlled environment and terminal success hides too many intermediate failures. Log state and tool outputs, test the active probes against known silent errors, and compare ternary process rewards with outcome-only rewards under identical task, tool, and rollout budgets.
当智能体能在受控环境中重放分析、而终局成功掩盖过多中间失败时，可使用 DataPRM。应记录状态和工具输出，用已知静默错误测试主动探测，并在相同任务、工具和生成预算下比较三元过程奖励与只看结果的奖励。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The most important audit unit is the executable state, not the prose explanation. Before reusing the method, ask which facts the probe can actually observe, which tool calls are replayable, and whether the stated reward distinguishes exploratory failure from unsupported conclusion.
最重要的审计单元是可执行状态，而不是文字解释。复用方法前，应询问探测器实际能观察哪些事实、哪些工具调用可以重放，以及所述奖励是否能区分探索性失败与没有依据的结论。
